title: Queued
description: One paper that entered the backlog (one JSON object per line in state/queued/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl, the month taken from queued_at). queue add appends these; discover reads them, with state/seen/, so a paper is judged once, whether it is waiting, in the feed, or left the backlog without a page.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

queued_at.description: UTC time the paper entered the backlog, RFC 3339.
